TFM - Modelización predictiva de la demanda para la mejora del dimensionamiento de stock en entornos empresariales¶

1. Imports¶

4. Definición variables¶

In [4]:
TARGET = 'udsVenta_rec'
FEATURES = ['bolOpen', 'bol_promo', 'bol_pico_ventas', 'cluster',
    'dia_semana', 'mes', 'num_semana', 'bol_fin_semana',
    'lag_7', 'lag_14', 'lag_21', 'lag_28',
    'rolling_media_7', 'rolling_media_28',
    'rolling_std_7', 'rolling_std_28']
FEATURES_SIN_CLUSTER = [f for f in FEATURES if f != 'cluster']
FECHA_CORTE = pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22')
N_ITER = 15
CV_SPLITS = 2

5. Separación datos train/test¶

In [5]:
df_train = df[df['fecha'] <= FECHA_CORTE].copy()
df_test = df[df['fecha'] > FECHA_CORTE].copy()
print(f'Train: {df_train["fecha"].min().date()} a {df_train["fecha"].max().date()} ({len(df_train):,} registros)')
print(f'Test: {df_test["fecha"].min().date()} a {df_test["fecha"].max().date()} ({len(df_test):,} registros)')

Train: 2024-03-22 a 2025-09-22 (473,550 registros)
Test: 2025-09-23 a 2026-03-22 (155,841 registros)

6. Definición de métricas¶

In [6]:
def calcular_metricas(y_real, y_pred, nombre):
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_real, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_real, y_pred))
    bias = np.mean(y_pred - y_real)
    return {'Modelo': nombre, 'RMSE': round(rmse, 4), 'MAE': round(mae, 4),
             'Bias': round(bias, 4)}

7. Benchmark: Seasonal Naïve¶

In [7]:
resultados_naive = []
for cid in sorted(df_test['cluster'].unique()):
    sub = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid].copy()
    mask = sub['lag_7'].notna()
    y_real = sub.loc[mask, TARGET]
    y_pred = sub.loc[mask, 'lag_7']
    m = calcular_metricas(y_real, y_pred, 'Seasonal Naive')
    m['cluster'] = cid
    m['n_obs'] = int(mask.sum())
    resultados_naive.append(m)

df_naive = pd.DataFrame(resultados_naive)[['cluster', 'n_obs', 'Modelo', 'RMSE', 'MAE', 'Bias']]
display(df_naive.style
    .background_gradient(subset=['RMSE'], cmap='Reds')
    .format({'MAE': '{:.4f}', 'RMSE': '{:.4f}', 'Bias': '{:.4f}'}))

8. Benchmark: Holt-Winters¶

In [8]:
resultados_hw = []
producto_cluster = df.drop_duplicates('producto').set_index('producto')['cluster'].to_dict()
t0 = time.time()
for prod in df['producto'].unique():
    s_train = df_train[df_train['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
    s_test = df_test[df_test['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
    if len(s_test) == 0:
        continue
    hw = ExponentialSmoothing(s_train, trend='add', seasonal='add',
                              seasonal_periods=7,
                              initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
    y_pred = np.maximum(hw.forecast(len(s_test)), 0)
    cid = producto_cluster[prod]
    m = calcular_metricas(s_test.values, y_pred, 'Holt-Winters')
    m['cluster'] = cid
    m['producto'] = prod
    m['n_obs'] = len(s_test)
    resultados_hw.append(m)

print(f'Completado en {time.time()-t0:.0f}s')
df_hw_prod = pd.DataFrame(resultados_hw)
df_hw = (df_hw_prod.groupby('cluster')
         .agg(n_obs=('n_obs', 'sum'), RMSE=('RMSE', 'mean'),
               MAE=('MAE', 'mean'), Bias=('Bias', 'mean'))
         .round(4).reset_index().assign(Modelo='Holt-Winters')
        )[['cluster', 'n_obs', 'Modelo', 'RMSE', 'MAE', 'Bias']]
display(df_hw.style
    .background_gradient(subset=['RMSE'], cmap='Reds')
    .format({'MAE': '{:.4f}', 'RMSE': '{:.4f}', 'Bias': '{:.4f}'}))

resultados_rf_base = []
modelos_rf_base = {}

for cid in sorted(df['cluster'].unique()):
    X_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]
    y_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][TARGET]
    X_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]

    m['cluster'] = cid

    resultados_rf_base.append(m)

10. Optimización de hiperparámetros — Random Forest¶

In [10]:
param_grid_rf = {'n_estimators': randint(100, 500),
    'max_depth': randint(5, 20),
    'min_samples_leaf': randint(1, 20),
    'max_features': uniform(0.3, 0.7)}
params_rf_opt = {}

for cid in sorted(df['cluster'].unique()):
    print(f'Buscando hiperparametros RF cluster {cid}...')
    t0 = time.time()
    X_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]
    y_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][TARGET]
    tscv = TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=CV_SPLITS)
    search = RandomizedSearchCV(RandomForestRegressor(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1),
        param_grid_rf, n_iter=N_ITER, cv=tscv,
        scoring='neg_root_mean_squared_error',
        random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, verbose=0    )
    search.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    best = search.best_params_.copy()
    best.update({'random_state': 42, 'n_jobs': -1})
    params_rf_opt[cid] = best

    print(f'RMSE CV: {-search.best_score_:.4f} ; Tiempo: {time.time()-t0:.0f}s')
    print(f'Params: {search.best_params_}')

15. Stacking (RF optimizado + XGBoost optimizado)¶

In [15]:
resultados_stacking = []
modelos_meta = {}

for cid in sorted(df['cluster'].unique()):
    print(f'Entrenando Stacking cluster {cid}...')
    t0 = time.time()

    X_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES].values
    y_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][TARGET].values
    X_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES].values
    y_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][TARGET].values

    tscv = TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=4)
    oof_rf  = np.full(len(X_tr), np.nan)
    oof_xgb = np.full(len(X_tr), np.nan)

    for idx_tr, idx_val in tscv.split(X_tr):
        rf_fold = RandomForestRegressor(**params_rf_opt[cid])
        rf_fold.fit(X_tr[idx_tr], y_tr[idx_tr])
        oof_rf[idx_val] = np.maximum(rf_fold.predict(X_tr[idx_val]), 0)

        xgb_fold = XGBRegressor(**params_xgb_opt[cid])
        xgb_fold.fit(X_tr[idx_tr], y_tr[idx_tr])
        oof_xgb[idx_val] = np.maximum(xgb_fold.predict(X_tr[idx_val]), 0)

    mask = ~np.isnan(oof_rf)
    meta = Ridge(alpha=1.0)
    meta.fit(np.column_stack([oof_rf[mask], oof_xgb[mask]]), y_tr[mask])
    modelos_meta[cid] = meta

    pred_rf  = np.maximum(modelos_rf[cid].predict(X_te), 0)
    pred_xgb = np.maximum(modelos_xgb[cid].predict(X_te), 0)
    y_pred   = np.maximum(meta.predict(np.column_stack([pred_rf, pred_xgb])), 0)

    m = calcular_metricas(y_te, y_pred, 'Stacking')
    m['cluster'] = cid
    m['n_obs']   = len(y_te)
    resultados_stacking.append(m)
    print(f'Cluster {cid} OK — {time.time()-t0:.0f}s')

df_stacking = pd.DataFrame(resultados_stacking)[['cluster', 'n_obs', 'Modelo', 'RMSE', 'MAE', 'Bias']]
display(df_stacking.style
    .background_gradient(subset=['RMSE'], cmap='Reds')
    .format({'MAE': '{:.4f}', 'RMSE': '{:.4f}', 'Bias': '{:.4f}'}))

16. Stacking_2 (RF optimizado + XGBoost optimizado + Ridge)¶

In [16]:
resultados_stacking_v2 = []
modelos_meta_v2 = {}
modelos_ridge_v2 = {}

for cid in sorted(df['cluster'].unique()):
    print(f'Entrenando Stacking v2 cluster {cid}...')
    t0 = time.time()

    X_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES].values
    y_tr = df_train[df_train['cluster'] == cid][TARGET].values
    X_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES].values
    y_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][TARGET].values

    tscv = TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=4)
    oof_rf    = np.full(len(X_tr), np.nan)
    oof_xgb   = np.full(len(X_tr), np.nan)
    oof_ridge = np.full(len(X_tr), np.nan)

    for idx_tr, idx_val in tscv.split(X_tr):
        rf_fold = RandomForestRegressor(**params_rf_opt[cid])
        rf_fold.fit(X_tr[idx_tr], y_tr[idx_tr])
        oof_rf[idx_val] = np.maximum(rf_fold.predict(X_tr[idx_val]), 0)

        xgb_fold = XGBRegressor(**params_xgb_opt[cid])
        xgb_fold.fit(X_tr[idx_tr], y_tr[idx_tr])
        oof_xgb[idx_val] = np.maximum(xgb_fold.predict(X_tr[idx_val]), 0)

        ridge_fold = Pipeline([('scaler', StandardScaler()), ('ridge', Ridge(alpha=1.0))])
        ridge_fold.fit(X_tr[idx_tr], y_tr[idx_tr])
        oof_ridge[idx_val] = np.maximum(ridge_fold.predict(X_tr[idx_val]), 0)

    mask = ~np.isnan(oof_rf)
    ridge_full = Pipeline([('scaler', StandardScaler()), ('ridge', Ridge(alpha=1.0))])
    ridge_full.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    modelos_ridge_v2[cid] = ridge_full

    meta_v2 = Ridge(alpha=1.0)
    meta_v2.fit(np.column_stack([oof_rf[mask], oof_xgb[mask], oof_ridge[mask]]), y_tr[mask])
    modelos_meta_v2[cid] = meta_v2

    pred_rf    = np.maximum(modelos_rf[cid].predict(X_te), 0)
    pred_xgb   = np.maximum(modelos_xgb[cid].predict(X_te), 0)
    pred_ridge = np.maximum(ridge_full.predict(X_te), 0)
    y_pred     = np.maximum(meta_v2.predict(np.column_stack([pred_rf, pred_xgb, pred_ridge])), 0)

    m = calcular_metricas(y_te, y_pred, 'Stacking v2')
    m['cluster'] = cid
    m['n_obs']   = len(y_te)
    resultados_stacking_v2.append(m)
    print(f'Cluster {cid} OK — {time.time()-t0:.0f}s')

df_stacking_v2 = pd.DataFrame(resultados_stacking_v2)[['cluster', 'n_obs', 'Modelo', 'RMSE', 'MAE', 'Bias']]
display(df_stacking_v2.style

    .format({'RMSE': '{:.4f}', 'MAE': '{:.4f}', 'Bias': '{:.4f}'}))

21. Walk - forward¶

In [23]:
VENTANAS = [{'nombre': 'Iter 1', 'train_fin': '2025-06-30', 'test_ini': '2025-07-01', 'test_fin': '2025-09-30'},
    {'nombre': 'Iter 2', 'train_fin': '2025-09-30', 'test_ini': '2025-10-01', 'test_fin': '2025-12-31'},
    {'nombre': 'Iter 3', 'train_fin': '2025-12-31', 'test_ini': '2026-01-01', 'test_fin': '2026-03-22'},]

resultados_wf = []

for ventana in VENTANAS:
    nombre = ventana['nombre']
    train_fin = pd.Timestamp(ventana['train_fin'])
    test_ini = pd.Timestamp(ventana['test_ini'])
    test_fin = pd.Timestamp(ventana['test_fin'])

    df_tr = df[df['fecha'] <= train_fin].copy()
    df_te = df[(df['fecha'] >= test_ini) & (df['fecha'] <= test_fin)].copy()

    print(f'{nombre}: Train a {train_fin.date()} ; Test {test_ini.date()} a {test_fin.date()} '
          f'({len(df_tr):,} / {len(df_te):,} registros)')

    for cid in sorted(df['cluster'].unique()):
        X_tr = df_tr[df_tr['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]
        y_tr = df_tr[df_tr['cluster'] == cid][TARGET]
        X_te = df_te[df_te['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]
        y_te = df_te[df_te['cluster'] == cid][TARGET]

        if len(X_te) == 0:
            continue

        if cid in [0, 1]:
            model = RandomForestRegressor(**params_rf_opt[cid])
            model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
            y_pred = np.maximum(model.predict(X_te), 0)
            nombre_modelo = 'Random Forest'
        else:
            preds = []
            reals = []
            for prod in df_te[df_te['cluster'] == cid]['producto'].unique():
                s_tr = df_tr[df_tr['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
                s_te = df_te[df_te['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
                if len(s_tr) < 14 or len(s_te) == 0:
                    continue
                try:
                    hw = ExponentialSmoothing(s_tr, trend='add', seasonal='add',
                                             seasonal_periods=7,
                                             initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
                    pred = np.maximum(hw.forecast(len(s_te)), 0)
                    preds.extend(pred)
                    reals.extend(s_te.values)
                except Exception:
                    continue
            y_pred = np.array(preds)
            y_te = np.array(reals)
            nombre_modelo = 'Holt-Winters'

        m = calcular_metricas(y_te, y_pred, nombre_modelo)
        m['iteracion'] = nombre
        m['cluster'] = cid
        m['n_obs'] = len(y_te)
        resultados_wf.append(m)

df_wf = pd.DataFrame(resultados_wf)[
    ['iteracion', 'cluster', 'n_obs', 'Modelo', 'RMSE', 'MAE', 'Bias']]
display(df_wf.style
    .background_gradient(subset=['RMSE'], cmap='RdYlGn_r')
    .format({'RMSE': '{:.4f}', 'MAE': '{:.4f}', 'Bias': '{:.4f}'}))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(18, 14))
nombres_dias = ['Lun', 'Mar', 'Mie', 'Jue', 'Vie', 'Sab', 'Dom']

for idx, cid in enumerate([0, 1]):
    X_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][FEATURES]
    y_te = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid][TARGET].values
    y_pred = np.maximum(modelos_rf[cid].predict(X_te), 0)
    residuos = y_pred - y_te
    fechas = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid]['fecha'].values
    dias = df_test[df_test['cluster'] == cid]['dia_semana'].values
    axes[idx, 0].scatter(fechas, residuos, alpha=0.1, s=1, color=COLORS['azul'])
    axes[idx, 0].axhline(0, color=COLORS['rojo'], linewidth=1)
    axes[idx, 0].set_title(f'Cluster {cid} — Residuos en el tiempo')
    axes[idx, 0].set_ylabel('Residuo')
    axes[idx, 1].hist(residuos, bins=60, color=COLORS['azul'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='white')
    axes[idx, 1].axvline(0, color=COLORS['rojo'], linewidth=1.5)
    axes[idx, 1].axvline(residuos.mean(), color=COLORS['naranja'], linewidth=1.5,
                         linestyle='--', label=f'Media: {residuos.mean():.4f}')
    axes[idx, 1].set_title(f'Cluster {cid} — Distribución de residuos')
    axes[idx, 1].set_xlabel('Residuo')
    axes[idx, 1].legend(fontsize=8)
    res_dias = [residuos[dias == d].mean() for d in range(7)]

    ], alpha=0.8)
    axes[idx, 2].axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
    axes[idx, 2].set_title(f'Cluster {cid} — Residuo medio por día semana')
    axes[idx, 2].set_ylabel('Residuo medio')

# Cluster 2 — Holt-Winters
residuos_hw = []
fechas_hw = []
dias_hw = []
for prod in df_test[df_test['cluster'] == 2]['producto'].unique():
    s_tr = df_train[df_train['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
    s_te = df_test[df_test['producto'] == prod].sort_values('fecha').set_index('fecha')[TARGET]
    if len(s_tr) < 14 or len(s_te) == 0:
        continue
    try:
        hw = ExponentialSmoothing(s_tr, trend='add', seasonal='add',
                                  seasonal_periods=7,
                                  initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
        pred = np.maximum(hw.forecast(len(s_te)), 0)
        res = pred - s_te.values
        residuos_hw.extend(res)
        fechas_hw.extend(s_te.index)
        dias_hw.extend(pd.DatetimeIndex(s_te.index).dayofweek)
    except Exception:
        continue

residuos_hw = np.array(residuos_hw)
dias_hw = np.array(dias_hw)

ax.plot(df_agg_c2.index, df_agg_c2['real'], color=COLORS['verde'], alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.6)
ax.plot(real_mm7.index, real_mm7.values, color=COLORS['verde'], linewidth=2, label='Real MM7')
ax.plot(pred_mm7.index, pred_mm7.values, color=COLORS['rojo'], linewidth=2,
        linestyle='--', label='Predicción MM7')
ax.set_title('Cluster 2 — Venta media diaria (Holt-Winters)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Unidades medias')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
